test_collision_driver: test the mjx collision driver by comparing JAX-based contact results against MuJoCo reference implementation
test_kinematics_jit: test the jit-compiled mjx.kinematics function for forward kinematics computation on JAX models

test_put_data: test mjx.put_data to convert a MuJoCo MjData into an MJX-compatible data object for JAX execution
